title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يشارك في مؤتمري الأئمة والخطباء بالكويت والتوريث العلمي بتركيا
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in Two Conferences: Imams and Preachers in Kuwait, and the Handing On of Learning in Turkey
body_ar: خلال جولته الأخيرة التي قادته لكل من الكويت وتركيا؛ شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو في العديد من المؤتمرات العلمية والدولية؛ حيث ألقى محاضرات ضمن برنامج تلك المؤتمرات، بالإضافة إلى قيامه بعدة محاضرات ولقاءات علمية وفكرية على هامش مشاركته في فعاليات مؤتمرين علميين أحدهما بالكويت والآخر بتركبا. وقد شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو في فعاليات المؤتمر الرابع للأئمة والخطباء الذي نظمته وزارة الأوقاف والشؤون الإسلامية بدولة الكويت في الفترة ما بين 12 إلى 14 ربيع الثاني 1433هـ الموافق: 05 إلى 07 مارس 2012 وقد قام فضيلته بتسجيل محاضرة على هامش المؤتمر، أكد فيها على أهمية دور الإمام ومنبر المسجد في تعزيز الوحدة الوطنية، ذكرا بعض الأدوار الاجتماعية التي يطلب من الإمام القيام بها، وعرج على موقف الإمام في الفتن، وقدم فضيلته خلال المحاضرة الفروق بين دوري الإمام الرسمي والفردي. كما شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو في المؤتمر الأول للتوريث العلمي والمنهجي من علماء الأمة إلى أئمة أوربا، والذي نظمه التجمع الأوربي للأئمة والمرشدين خلال الفترة من 29 ربيع الثاني إلى غرة جمادى الأولى 1433هـ الموافق: 22 إلى 25 مارس 2012 بمدينة اسطنبول التركية، وقد ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محاضرتين؛ كانت أولاهما تحت عنوان: أثر الأستاذ والإجازة في توريث العلم، أما الثانية فعنوانها: الإمام القدوة : هدياً وعلماً وسمتاً. وعلى هامش مشاركته في هذا المؤتمر بتركيا التقى فضيلة الشيخ ببعض الجالية الموريتانية هناك، وألقى محاضرة أمام الطلبة الموريتانيين في تركيا تحت إشراف جمعية الحكمة التركية السبت 01 جمادى الأولى 1433هـ الموافق: 24 مارس 2012 تحت عنوان: "دور الشباب في البناء والإصلاح"، وألقى أيضا خلال تواجده بتركيا خطبة جمعة. لمتابعة المواد: - دور الإمام في تعزيز الوحدة الوطنية - دور الشباب في البناء والإصلاح - الإمام قدوة - أثر الإسناد والإجازة في توريث العلوم
body_en:
During his recent tour, which took him to both Kuwait and Turkey, Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew took part in a number of scholarly and international conferences, delivering lectures within the programmes of those conferences, besides giving several lectures and holding scholarly and intellectual meetings on the margins of his participation in the proceedings of two scholarly conferences, one of them in Kuwait and the other in Turkey.

Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew took part in the proceedings of the Fourth Conference for Imams and Preachers, organised by the Ministry of Endowments and Islamic Affairs in the State of Kuwait in the period from 12 to 14 Rabi' al-Thani 1433 AH, corresponding to 5 to 7 March 2012. He recorded a lecture on the margins of the conference in which he affirmed the importance of the role of the imam and of the mosque pulpit in strengthening national unity, recalling some of the social roles the imam is called upon to perform; he touched on the imam's stance amid civil strife (fitan), and set out during the lecture the differences between the imam's official role and his individual one.

Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew also took part in the First Conference on the Handing On of Learning and of Method from the Scholars of the Community to the Imams of Europe, organised by the European Assembly of Imams and Spiritual Guides in the period from 29 Rabi' al-Thani to the first of Jumada al-Ula 1433 AH, corresponding to 22 to 25 March 2012, in the Turkish city of Istanbul. The Sheikh delivered two lectures. The first was under the title "The Effect of the Teacher and of the Licence to Transmit (ijāzah) in the Handing On of Knowledge"; the second was entitled "The Imam as Exemplar: In Guidance, in Knowledge and in Bearing".

On the margins of his participation in this conference in Turkey the Sheikh met with some of the Mauritanian community there, and delivered a lecture before the Mauritanian students in Turkey under the auspices of the Turkish al-Hikmah Association, on Saturday 1 Jumada al-Ula 1433 AH, corresponding to 24 March 2012, under the title "The Role of Young People in Building and Reform". During his stay in Turkey he also delivered a Friday sermon (khuṭbah).

To follow the materials: — "The Role of the Imam in Strengthening National Unity" — "The Role of Young People in Building and Reform" — "The Imam as Exemplar" — "The Effect of the Chain of Transmission (isnād) and of the Licence to Transmit in the Handing On of the Sciences"

flags.arabic: أثر الأستاذ والإجازة في توريث العلم / أثر الإسناد والإجازة في توريث العلوم
flags.context: the same lecture titled one way in the body and another in the list of materials at the foot
options: render both as the source gives them and flag the conflict
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT. The record names this lecture twice and differently: 'the teacher' (al-ustādh) in the body, 'the chain of transmission' (al-isnād) in the list of links, with 'knowledge' singular in one and 'the sciences' plural in the other. The two readings differ in substance — one is about the person of the teacher, the other about the formal chain — and the Arabic words are close enough in outline for either to be the slip. Both are rendered as served. A reviewer should settle it against the recording before the title is quoted.

flags.context: مؤتمرين علميين أحدهما بالكويت والآخر بتركبا
options: read as بتركيا, 'in Turkey', as the same record spells it three other times
flags.note: Source typo (تركبا for تركيا). Preserved in body_ar, rendered on the obvious reading, flagged rather than fixed.

flags.context: أكد فيها على أهمية دور الإمام ... ذكرا بعض الأدوار الاجتماعية
options: read ذكرا as a verbal noun
flags.note: The form as served does not parse in this position. Either مذكّرا or ذاكرا would, and they differ only in nuance; 'recalling' is used as it covers both. Preserved and flagged, not fixed.

flags.context: وعرج على موقف الإمام في الفتن
options: the imam's stance amid civil strife (fitan)
the imam's position during times of trial
flags.note: The record says the Sheikh addressed the imam's stance during fitan and says nothing whatever about what that stance should be. This is a live and consequential question — what a state-appointed imam does when a society is in conflict — and the corpus holds only the fact that he spoke on it. Nothing may be inferred. fitan carries both 'civil strife' and 'trials/temptations'; in the context of the imam's public role the former is intended, but the corpus has no text to confirm it.

translator_notes: A news-desk summary of two conference appearances. No lecture text is present; four recordings are pointed to and the corpus does not hold them.
The CMS timestamp, 1 April 2012, is a bulk-upload date. The body's own dates (5–7 March and 22–25 March 2012) are the event dates.

'التوريث العلمي' is rendered 'the handing on of learning' rather than 'inheritance': the conference concerns the transmission of scholarship from one generation to the next, and 'inheritance' would collide with farāʾiḍ, the law of inheritance shares, in the glossary.
'الإجازة' is the scholarly licence to transmit a text. It is not in the glossary and is bracketed on first occurrence.
